$comment: Recording link providers (brief B9, C9). Same matching rule as meeting-platforms.json; libs/utils has no resolver for recordings yet. No dot: a recording is not a live meeting. An unknown host shows the host alone, never 'Bilinmeyen platform'. DRAFT host lists, not verified against real recording links. Rules: MDS-COL-06, MDS-DOM-05.

fields.label: the chip's text
fields.hostSuffixes: the hosts matched, with every subdomain
fields.embed: true: plays in an embedded player on the page; otherwise the card links out
fields.embedHost: the host the embedded player loads from
fields.note: what to know before relying on the row
fields.uiLabel: what the UI shows for an unknown host; null = the host alone
fields.showHost: true: the link's host is shown, in dir="ltr"

providers.label: YouTube
providers.note: the brief asks for the privacy-enhanced embed; Medaris uploads are unlisted (liste dışı): anyone with the link can watch

providers.label: Google Drive
providers.note: Google Meet saves its recordings to Drive, so a Meet recording usually arrives as a Drive link

providers.label: Google Meet
providers.note: a meet.google.com link is normally a meeting room, not a recording; whether a recording can live on this host is not verified
